title.narrative: Strengthening Water Sector Capacities through Ecohydrology and IWRM & Response to the AU 2026 Theme on Water and Sanitation

description.narrative: This activity will support the conduct of a capacity gap and needs assessment in the water sector, including an in-depth analysis in Ethiopia as a pilot country, with a specific focus on ecohydrology, Integrated Water Resources Management, and the water-energy-food-ecosystems nexus. The assessment will evaluate institutional, technical, and human resource capacities required to implement Ethiopia's national IWRM framework, including the revised water policy, basin plans, and the Buffer Zone Proclamation, and to scale ecohydrology as a nature-based, climate-smart approach across the water, energy, and agriculture sectors in alignment with the Green Legacy Initiative. This initiative will inform targeted capacity-development frameworks aligned to the Africa Water Vision and Policy 2063 and contribute to Outcome 5 of the AU 2026 Action Framework on Water and Sanitation. The activity will be implemented in partnership with the Ministry of Water and Energy, ARCE, the IHP National Committee, and relevant regional and continental institutions.
